derivation_rule: D667: for each non-root unit, parent-relative Authority segment = <Scope Unit ID>_<Label>_<order.number>_<Name> when ordered, omitting order for unordered and omitting absent label; Delivery segment omits ID. Project Authority root is .caprmedio_<project name>. D442 says declarations do not author folder names. D302 governs filename tokens, not directory segments. D466 governs Status subdirectories, not Scope Unit identity folders.

boundaries: Scope Unit Declaration claims are the source of ID, Name, Label, ordering and parent values; folder paths are derived from those fields.

Only canonical Authority tree paths under .caprmedio_caprmedio and the repository-level Delivery tree were compared. The duplicate 000_CAPRMEDIO_framework package-like tree and applicable_methodology mirrors were excluded from Authority counts; they are not declared Scope Unit folder paths.

D667 specifies derivation and parent placement; this comparison alone does not establish that every declared Scope Unit must have materialized Authority and Delivery directories. Missing folders are reported as absent, not mislabeled as derivation mismatches.
No folder moves, source edits, implementations, tests, workflows or Git operations were performed.
directory_comparison_note: D667 provides an explicit Delivery naming formula. Exact present/absent status is reported per derived path; three actual directories use the Authority-form ID prefix at the expected Delivery parent and are therefore name mismatches.
